summary: A monthly drop-in business networking lunch at Elena's Mexican Grill in Candler, NC, run by Incredible Towns of WNC as one chapter of its region-wide IBN program. Listings explicitly state it is open to all with never any dues, fees, restrictions, exclusions, or membership requirements, matching the open drop-in format found for the sibling IBN chapters (Arden, Asheville, Asheville West, Brevard/Pisgah Forest, East Asheville, Woodfin).

evidence.note: Listing text: 'IBN Biz Lunch – Candler is open to all. Never any dues, fees, restrictions, exclusions, or membership requirements.'
Earlier 2024 listing uses identical open-to-all language, no membership framing.
Only 2 listings 973 days apart (2024-01-09 and 2026-09-08), consistent with a low-frequency recurring drop-in rather than a tightly tracked membership event.

Parent org page confirms IBN is a free, no-membership networking format run across multiple WNC towns; Candler chapter meets 2nd Tuesday monthly, noon-1pm, at Elena's Mexican Grill, same 'no cost, open to all, no fees/dues/exclusions' framing.
